text: Before leaving. <break time="0.8s" /> The king went out. <break time="0.8s" /> To find the hermit. <break time="0.8s" /> And ask him the questions. <break time="0.8s" /> One last time. <break time="0.8s" /> The hermit was on his knees. <break time="0.8s" /> Sowing seeds in the beds. <break time="0.8s" /> That the king had dug the day before. <break time="0.8s" /> You have already been answered. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the hermit. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking up at the king. <break time="0.8s" /> If you had not felt sorry. <break time="0.8s" /> For my weakness. <break time="0.8s" /> And stayed with me. <break time="0.8s" /> That man would have attacked you. <break time="0.8s" /> So the most important time. <break time="0.8s" /> Was when you were digging. <break time="0.8s" /> And I was the most important person. <break time="0.8s" /> And to do good for me. <break time="0.8s" /> Was your most important work. <break time="0.8s" /> Later when that man ran to us. <break time="0.8s" /> The most important time. <break time="0.8s" /> Was when you were caring for him. <break time="0.8s" /> If you had not bandaged his wound. <break time="0.8s" /> He would have died. <break time="0.8s" /> Without making peace with you. <break time="0.8s" /> Remember there is only one important time. <break time="0.8s" /> And that is now. <break time="0.8s" /> Because it is the only time. <break time="0.8s" /> We have power over. <break time="0.8s" /> The most important person. <break time="0.8s" /> Is the one you are with for nobody knows. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether he will meet anyone else. <break time="0.8s" /> And the most important thing. <break time="0.8s" /> Is to do good for that person. <break time="0.8s" /> Because that is why. <break time="0.8s" /> We were sent into this life.
